purpose: Route the current reconstruction batch without overwriting existing authority. Approved/reviewable assets land under existing image IDs; contaminated attempts remain outside the site drop-in tree.
routing_rule: Upload only the contents of DROP-INTO-PROJECTS-ROOT to the Projects repository root. Do not upload HOLD-NOT-FOR-SITE.
